profile_text.body:
Box is a publicly traded company, founded in 2005 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, that describes itself as an intelligent content management platform. Its site positions the platform around storing, sharing, and collaborating on unstructured data, such as lease agreements, sales presentations, and employee handbooks, with enterprise-grade security and compliance tools covering requirements including GDPR, HIPAA, and FINRA. The platform includes a drag-and-drop workflow builder, AI-driven malware detection, automated data classification, granular access controls, and e-signature capabilities that the company says are available at no additional cost with unlimited usage.

Box AI is the company's primary AI product, tracked under the notes, knowledge, and meetings category, and is described on the site as drawing on models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google to deliver real-time summaries, deep analysis, metadata extraction, and smart recommendations across enterprise content. The site also references Box AI Studio, a tool for customizing and deploying AI agents to automate workflows, and describes the broader platform as supporting agentic experiences for developers building on top of its infrastructure.

Box files with the SEC under CIK 0001372612 and trades under the ticker BOX. Its most recently reported annual revenue, from a 10-K covering the period ending January 31, 2026, was $1,177,253,000. No litigation is recorded in the held facts for this company.
